$comment: JSON shape Claude must return when reading a photo of a shopping list (demo endpoint POST /demo/shopping-list). Source of truth: backend/src/ai/shoppingList.ts mirrors it and a test checks they match. Sent to the API without this $comment key.

kind.description: What the photo shows. A receipt is a printed bill from a shop; a shopping list is things someone plans to buy.

items.description: One entry per line of the list, in written order. Empty unless kind is shopping_list.

raw_text.description: The line exactly as written, in its original script.

name_en.description: Short English name of the item, e.g. "milk".

quantity.description: How many packs or units to buy. 1 if no amount is written.

unit.description: The unit as written (kg, bottle, كيلو, علبة…), or null.

product_id.description: The id of the matching catalogue product, or null if none matches.
